notes.title: One of my favorite puzzle games ever is free for the week on the Epic Games Store
notes.content: Monument Valley is a wonderful puzzle game: I know it, Josh knows it, and now you can know it too and without spending a dime, because Epic Games has made it free for the week to kick off its 2025 End of Summer Sale... Read more.

notes.title: The Monument Valley soundtrack, now on Steam
notes.content:
[p]We are thrilled to announce that the highly praised Monument Valley soundtrack is now available for purchase on Steam. Immerse yourself in the meditative ambiance and melodic experiments of Stafford Brawler, OBFUSC, and GRIGORI with this official soundtrack for the award-winning game.[/p][p][/p][p]This 16-song album, which perfectly complements the game's elegant interactive experience, can now be enjoyed at your leisure.[/p][p][/p][p][url="http://store.steampowered.com/app/3864500/"]http://store.steampowered.com/app/3864500/[/url][/p][p][dynamiclink href="http://store.steampowered.com/app/3864500/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]We’re still hard at work on The Garden of Life, the upcoming free DLC for [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3132930/Monument_Valley_3/"]Monument Valley 3.[/url] But after releasing the Monument Valley 3 soundtrack alongside the full release of that game on July 22nd, we heard from so many of you that we should add the Monument Valley soundtrack too!
[/p][p]Complete your collection by picking up the Monument Valley, Monument Valley 2 and Monument Valley 3 soundtracks now:[/p][p][/p][p][url="http://store.steampowered.com/app/3864510/"]http://store.steampowered.com/app/3864510/[/url][/p][p] [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3846460/Monument_Valley_3__Original_Soundtrack/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Your friends,[/p][p]ustwo games[/p]

notes.title: Building The Impossible: The Making of Monument Valley 3
notes.content:
[h2][b]Building the Impossible - The Making of Monument Valley 3[/b][/h2][p][/p][previewyoutube="pjsLWH0mCVk;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We’re so excited to share this new documentary about the making of Monument Valley 3 with our fans. Learn about how we built the game, the inspirations behind our creative vision and the impact we hope the game will have on the world![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3132930/Monument_Valley_3/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Monument Valley 3 has been out for over a week now, and we've been delighted with the response from our players so far. Thank you all so much for playing and joining us on Noor's voyage.

We can't wait to show you what's in store for The Garden of Life later this year.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Our Commitment to Funding Flood Relief Programmes[/b][/p][p]As showcased in our documentary, we’ve made a commitment to donate 3% of all profits generated by Monument Valley 3 to flood relief programmes by the IFRC. By purchasing and playing Monument Valley 3, you’re helping communities affected by devastating floods around the world.[/p][p][/p][p]Find out more about our partnership with IFRC here: [/p][p][url="https://ustwogames.co.uk/news/ustwo-games-x-ifrc/"]https://ustwogames.co.uk/news/ustwo-games-x-ifrc/[/url][/p][p] [/p][p]Many thanks for your continued support[/p][p][/p][p]Your friends,[/p][p]ustwo games[/p]

notes.title: Monument Valley 3 is OUT NOW
notes.content:
[h2][b]Monument Valley 3 is officially OUT NOW on Steam![/b][/h2][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3132930/Monument_Valley_3/"][/dynamiclink][i]Launch discount of 10% available until 5th August 2025.[/i]

Dear Monument Valley fans - we're excited to share news of the newest instalment in the series![/p][p]Experience Monument Valley 3 with cinematic widescreen, stunning art design and impossible landscapes, all fully playable with gamepad or keyboard and mouse.
[/p][p]Noor must seek out a new source of light before darkness overtakes her world. Guide her through sprawling cities, coastal harbours, and abstract, ethereal realms.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]More content planned for Monument Valley 3, later this year[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558643/a0f6e3b9f553b782be78f75fb96e2267384ff770.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re excited to let you know that we will be releasing more content for Monument Valley 3 later this year. We will release this content - The Garden of Life - [b]free for all players[/b]. [/p][p]More information to be shared with you soon![/p][p][/p][h2][b]3% of Profits Will Go to Flood Relief Programmes[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558643/96a2068a0f005e2b3518cadcd814569cb4bb3450.png"][/img][/p][p]As a reminder, 3% of all profits generated by Monument Valley 3 will be donated to flood relief programmes by the IFRC. [/p][p]As the rainy season begins in places such as South America and devastating floods continue to impact communities, we’re deeply grateful to our players - your support is helping deliver clean water, sanitation and support to families in need. Thank you.
[/p][p]Your friends,[/p][p]ustwo games[/p]

notes.title: A Behind-the-Scenes look at Monument Valley 3
notes.content: [p]We’re so excited to share a small teaser of this new upcoming documentary about the making of [b]Monument Valley 3[/b] with you.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="7RgDSO-i1gI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]The full documentary will be released very soon, and includes insight into how we built the games, the inspirations behind our creative vision and the impact we hope the newest instalment, Monument Valley 3, will have on the world![/p][p]We hope you enjoy this little sneak-peek at what the full documentary will entail.[/p][p]As a reminder, Monument Valley 3 will be releasing on Steam just next week on July 22nd![/p][p][/p][p]Wishlist using the link below:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3132930/Monument_Valley_3/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thank you again for all your support during this journey.[/p][p]Your friends, [/p][p]ustwo games[/p]

notes.title: Stream the Monument Valley 3 Soundtrack Now
notes.content:
[p]We’re delighted to share that the official Monument Valley 3 digital soundtrack is now available to stream on [url="https://open.spotify.com/album/1O8s3BqsAmrczfIkcWCDkl?si=TdUX6f1kTmSB4kdd_9DFYQ"]Spotify[/url], [url="https://music.apple.com/us/album/monument-valley-3-original-game-soundtrack/1816219122"]Apple Music[/url], [url="https://music.youtube.com/watch?v=R9KeQfaXFqo&list=OLAK5uy_lWAsA69NFUfog1nk28tZPoSCdow5OC120"]YouTube Music[/url] and more.[/p][p][/p][p]For Monument Valley 3, we didn’t just see game audio as a backdrop, but as an integral and emotionally resonant part of the player experience. Todd Baker and Lucie Treacher have created this beautiful, dynamic soundscape that we’re so excited to share with you. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="R9KeQfaXFqo;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Whether you’re wanting to revisit your experience of playing Monument Valley 3, or simply looking for a moment of calm in your day, we hope this music offers you a place to pause, reflect and breathe. [/p][p]For those that would like to own the soundtrack, [b]it will also be available here on Steam too[/b] when the full game releases on 22nd July. [/p][p]And of course, you're also still able to stream the soundtracks to [url="https://open.spotify.com/album/1DVCNAcMAd2eCgOmC84m2P"]Monument Valley[/url], [url="https://open.spotify.com/album/1dKwykVXwQ59ehjUxFKRRw"]Monument Valley: Forgotten Shores [/url] and [url="https://open.spotify.com/album/0BRkQHI4BLdepnzr9QLRu1"]Monument Valley 2[/url] on all music streaming platforms too![/p][p]If you haven’t done so already, wishlisting Monument Valley 3 is the best way to support us and stay updated and across all our upcoming announcements as we prepare for launch.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3132930/Monument_Valley_3/"][/dynamiclink]Thank you for your continued support. We still have some more exciting announcements to share ahead of release. We will be in touch soon.
[/p][p]Your friends,[/p][p]ustwo games[/p]

notes.title: A Sneak Peek into Monument Valley 3 – Watch the Wholesome Direct Reveal!
notes.content:
[p]We’re thrilled to share that Monument Valley 3 was recently featured as part of this year’s Wholesome Direct showcase.[/p][p]
Every year, the Wholesome Direct celebrates cozy games that bring a sense of calm, beauty and joy to all their players. We couldn’t be happier to be featured alongside so many brilliant games, studios and creators making such thoughtful and uplifting experiences. [/p][p][/p][p]If you haven’t had the chance to catch our little feature yet, you can find it here as part of the Wholesome Direct showcase: [/p][previewyoutube="HiJI8g9j56c;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Monument Valley 3 releases on Steam very soon (July 22nd!), and we’re so grateful for your support so far. All the excitement we see in comments, on our social channels like [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@ustwo.games"]TikTok[/url] and [url="https://www.instagram.com/ustwogames/"]Instagram[/url], means everything to us. We can’t wait for you to join us on Noor’s journey.[/p][p][/p][p]If you haven’t done so already, wishlisting Monument Valley 3 is the best way to support us and stay updated and across all our upcoming announcements as we prepare for launch. We have some very exciting new things to announce over the coming few weeks, and we wouldn’t want you to miss them.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3132930/Monument_Valley_3/"][/dynamiclink]Also, lots of you seemed to enjoy trying our Monument Valley 3 demo that was made available for Steam Next Fest - so we’ve decided to keep it available! Check it out on the store page above.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being part of our journey so far. We can’t wait to share more soon. [/p][p][/p][p]Your friends,[/p][p]ustwo games[/p]

notes.title: Monument Valley 3 coming to Steam July 22nd – Play the demo now!
notes.content: [p]Revealed during the recent Wholesome Direct livestream at Summer Game Fest, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3132930/Monument_Valley_3/"]this next chapter in the beloved Monument Valley series[/url] brings our most expansive and emotional puzzle adventure to PC – fully optimised for keyboard & mouse or controller, and complete with our first major seasonal update, The Garden of Life.   [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3132930/Monument_Valley_3/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]But you don’t have to wait until July to begin your journey: A playable demo is now available to mark [b]Steam Next Fest (June 9–16)![/b]  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558643/8b0fe92b4f2d72f01f3d6637b1175ce1a0a773b6.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Step into Noor’s world, solve your first impossible puzzles, and get a taste of the breathtaking visuals, serene soundscapes and mind-bending exploration that define Monument Valley 3.[/b] [b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]What to Expect:[/b]  [/p][list][*][p]A cinematic adventure with stunning, surreal architecture [/p][/*][*][p]Noor’s biggest journey yet through harbours, cities, and flood-altered realms [/p][/*][*][p]New mechanics and puzzles in every chapter [/p][/*][*][p]Sail across surreal waters in a Monument Valley first [/p][/*][*][p]Seasonal updates starting with The Garden of Life, with more to come post-launch [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Plus, later this summer we’ll be sharing:[/b][/p][list][*][p] A behind-the-scenes Making Of documentary [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p] The official soundtrack (digital and vinyl) [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As part of our commitment to real-world impact, 3% of profits from Monument Valley 3 are being donated to Flood Relief via our partnership with the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (IFRC). So far, players have helped us raise $80,000 – thank you, and find out more about our impact journey here [url="https://ustwogames.co.uk/mv3-impact"]https://ustwogames.co.uk/mv3-impact[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558643/7624b006e39292d96d9565fcc3a716d6fd628f25.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Mark your calendars![/b][/p][p]Demo available now during Steam Next Fest.[/p][p]Full Steam release: July 22nd[/p][p][/p][p]Wishlisting helps us a ton, so if you haven’t already, hit that star and let Noor’s journey begin!   [/p][p][/p][p]Plus, these channels will also keep you fully up-to-date on all things Monument Valley:  [/p][p]Sign up for the latest updates: [url="http://go.ustwo.games/SignUp"]http://go.ustwo.games/SignUp[/url] [/p][p]Join the Monument Valley community on Discord: [url="https://go.ustwo.games/discord"]https://go.ustwo.games/discord[/url] [/p][p]Visit the Monument Valley website: [url="https://www.monumentvalleygame.com"]www.monumentvalleygame.com[/url]   [/p][p][/p][p]From your friends,   [/p][p]ustwo games [/p][p][/p]

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/04/monument-valley-1-and-2-get-full-controller-support-which-should-get-them-steam-deck-verified-soon/

notes.title: Controller Support and Steam Deck Verification is Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465049/a59864a84ce9f550550d9224f23071180d938d05.gif[/img]

Hey everyone,

It’s been a while but we’ve got some exciting news.

[h3][i]Monument Valley[/i] and [i]Monument Valley 2[/i] now have [b]full controller support! [/b][/h3]

Whether you’re relaxing with a gamepad on the couch or just prefer the tactile feel of analog sticks, you can now guide Ida and Ro through their journeys with your controller of choice.

[b]We are also delighted to announce that the games are now Steam Deck Verified![/b]

This update is available to all players on Steam. Just update your game and you’re good to go!

We’re always listening and looking for ways to improve your experience, and we know controller support has been a popular request. We hope this makes your time in these beautiful worlds even more seamless and enjoyable.

As always, thank you for your support - and if you’ve been meaning to replay the games or introduce them to someone new, now’s a great time.

Your friends,

[i]ustwo games[/i]

notes.title: Monument Valley is 10 Years old!
notes.content:
[h2]Can you believe it's been 10 years since Monument Valley first tripped us into a world of illusions and stole our hearts?[/h2]

It's pretty crazy to think back to that initial launch on iOS was 10 years ago- and the incredible journey it's taken us all on.

To celebrate this monumental milestone, we're throwing a year -long celebration for the game and its fans![url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/25548/Monument_Valley_Panoramic_Collection/][b] Kicking off with an epic discount on Monument Valley 1 and 2 Panoramic Edition![/b][/url]

We've also got a ton of fun stuff planned, from exclusive content and behind-the-scenes peeks to awesome community events and even a special musical performance from the game's composer, Todd Baker!

[h2]First up though, check our Anniversary Hype video:[/h2]
[previewyoutube=m7bVJ02WKbA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Here's a taste of what you can expect:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Discounts on Steam! Grab the Monument Valley: Panoramic Edition and Monument Valley 2: Panoramic Edition bundle to experience the entire mind-bending saga at a discounted price.

[*] A brand new website! Feast your eyes [url=https://ustwogames.co.uk/]https://ustwogames.co.uk/[/url]

[*] An awesome MV10 Hub! For all things Monument Valley, including behind the scenes, wallpapers and more. Stay tuned to our [url=https://ustwogames.co.uk/mv10/]Anniversary Web hub.[/url]

[*] Community Events: We'll be hosting online and offline events throughout the year, so keep an eye out for a chance to connect with other Monument Valley fans! We've even got a special activation planned for Develop:Brighton in July.
[/list]

There's so much more to come, so make sure you follow ustwo games on social media and use the hashtag #MV10 to join the celebration. Let's reminisce about mind-bending puzzles, impossible architecture, and the wistful journey of Ida

Here's to another decade of illusions and impossible journeys!

Your friends,

ustwo games

notes.title: Our latest game, Desta: The Memories Between, is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hey there,

It's Jamie from ustwo games here! 

I wanted to let everyone in our Monument Valley community know that our latest game Desta: The Memories Between, is out now. 

[previewyoutube=52updsB_oC0;full][/previewyoutube]

At ustwo games, we're always interested in creating new and different experiences for our community, and Desta is no different. We hope there's a lot that [i][b]Monument Valley[/b][/i] players will like here. From the gorgeous and scenic artwork, to the mysterious and immersive storytelling, all while embracing and making accessible a genre in tactics games that isn't particularly known for its relatable themes and moments!

For Steam players, we worked hard to make this the biggest release we could. [i][b]Dream Team Edition[/b][/i] is the digital collector’s edition the game - compiling all major content updates together, including all characters, new game modes (including Challenge Mode and Nightmare Mode), as well a complete game soundtrack composed by acclaimed UK Artist Mansur Brown and a beautiful Digital Art Book! We really believe this is the ultimate bundle for fans of ustwo games!

Desta is out now and launching with an exclusive 15% off discount offer!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2009650/

[i][b]Desta: The Memories Between[/b][/i] is also included in the complete ustwo games bundle collection - for those who are still waiting to buy our other titles such as [i][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1202900/Assemble_with_Care/]Assemble With Care[/url][/b][/i] and [i][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1337010/Alba_A_Wildlife_Adventure/]Alba: A Wildlife Adventure[/url][/b][/i].

We will have more updates on the future of [i][b]Monument Valley[/b][/i] in the future. Stay tuned.

Your friends,

ustwo games

notes.title: Monument Valley: Panoramic Editions 1 + 2 coming soon - wishlist now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42465049/e8abd6a5505856b86868f5be7e27306eba9d0f99.png[/img]

[h2]Kicking off our ‘summer of ustwo games'; we are incredibly proud to present an entirely new way to play one of our most beloved titles, right here on Steam. [/h2]

[h3]Introducing… Monument Valley: Panoramic Collection[/h3]

Our Panoramic Collection consists of two brand new game releases from us -

[list]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1927720/Monument_Valley_Panoramic_Edition]Monument Valley: Panoramic Edition [/url]
[*] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1927740/Monument_Valley_2_Panoramic_Edition]Monument Valley 2: Panoramic Edition [/url]
[/list]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/9753427/sale/MonumentValleyPC]VISIT THE SALE PAGE HERE![/url]

Together, these editions create our Panoramic Collection. Built exclusively for PC and ultra-wide displays, these editions are reimagined from the ground up for keyboard and mouse/touchpad support, and feature every single world, add-on and DLC ever lovingly made. 

For some longtime fans of ours, you might be asking - [i]‘but why now?’ [/i]

And it’s a good question. [b]Here at ustwo games, we have never stopped loving Monument Valley[/b] - it's so important to who we are, and to this day, helps us drive forward as a studio with unity. What was initially an experiment quickly ended up becoming something more.

Now, we are excited about the opportunity to open up and expand the world of Monument Valley without any restrictions - this is the widest, richest, and most beautiful version of Monument Valley you can ever play. 

Thanks to everyone who has ever played, recommended, and shown Monument Valley to their friends and family and made Monument Valley grow into a world bigger than we ever could have imagined. Here’s to the world of illusions always expanding.

See you on 12 July. 

Your friends,

[b]ustwo games[/b]
